description: Save a caption template (text the team reuses, like a sign-off or an offer) or a hashtag set. Names are unique per kind in a workspace.

body.description: For a hashtag set: tags separated by spaces or commas, with or without #.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

kind.description: caption: text inserted as written. hashtags: a set of #tags.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: template_create
title: Save a template
